name: web-sources
description: Approved public web sources only: SAP Help Portal, SAP Community, other SAP sites and a few news sites. No login, read only.

tools.name: search_sap_help
tools.description: Search the public SAP Help Portal (help.sap.com, no login) for documentation and support content. Read only.

tools.name: search_sap_community
tools.description: Search SAP Community (community.sap.com, no login) for questions, answers and blogs. Read only.

tools.name: list_web_sources
tools.description: List the approved web sources: all public SAP sites, Handelsblatt and FAZ.

tools.name: fetch_web_page
tools.description: Read one public page of an approved source (SAP sites, Handelsblatt, FAZ). No login or paywall bypass. Read only.

tools.name: search_web_sources
tools.description: Search an approved source with its own site search (best effort). Read only.
